yesterday.title: Tempo workout instead of easy group run
yesterday.summary: Garmin recorded a 7.22 km tempo-interval run in 40m 16s at 5:35/km, average HR 157, maximum HR 182 and load 161.
yesterday.prescribed: 40–50 minutes easy with the group at conversational RPE 2–3; no tempo, intervals, strides or fast finish.
yesterday.completed: Running · 7.22 km · 40m 16s · 5:35/km · average HR 157 · maximum HR 182 · load 161 · aerobic effect 3.9 · anaerobic effect 0.6 · elevation gain 181 m.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: Did not follow. Garmin classifies the recorded activity as a tempo workout with intensity intervals, rather than the prescribed easy group run.
adherence_evidence: The 15 October report prescribed an easy group run with no tempo or intervals.
Garmin named the activity “Tempo 2km Repeats” and recorded training effect “TEMPO” with intensity intervals.
adherence_caveats: Garmin does not identify the heart-rate sensor source in the available summary.
No perceived effort, symptoms, terrain or intent is inferred.

recommendation.title: Full rest from running and cycling
details: Optional: 20–30 minutes of easy walking or gentle mobility.
Do not add the optional Friday run or make up missed mileage.
Resume only when the recovery timer and how you feel support it.
recommendation.alternative: Full rest is preferred; optional easy walking or mobility only.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop activity for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual fatigue, illness, chest symptoms or other concerning symptoms.
